statement: S100 (owner review of S99, 2026-10-20; verbatim in .claude/skills/pee-guided-learning/references/owner-review-s99-rule-governance-2026-10-20.md): the statement role, nature and provenance of an observation are decided once, by claims from typed evidence cues about that occurrence and its context, under the precedence policy of knowledge_rules.ts (constraint > explicit > inherited; narrowest scope; equal-level disagreement abstains; defaults are presumptions). Which extractor found the value is a presumption only. Cue readers in src/observation_semantics.ts emit the cues.

vocabulary.name: cue
vocabulary.meaning: a typed piece of evidence about an observation: its kind (a cue family read by a registered cue reader) and the scope it was read at

vocabulary.name: claim
vocabulary.meaning: what a piece of evidence supports for one field of the observation, with its authority (tier) and scope

programs.statement: Statement role, nature and provenance of one observation from its evidence cues.

rules.statement: the value modifies a norm noun ("the 44 dB standard", "a limit of 70 dB"): the number is the norm, not the product's value: role norm.
rules.source: JCGM 200:2012 (VIM) 2.10 measured quantity value vs 4.26 maximum permissible value

rules.statement: the value modifies a reference mark compared against ("breaches the 80-decibel mark"): the number is the reference, not the product's value: role threshold.
rules.source: JCGM 200:2012 (VIM) 2.10 measured quantity value vs 4.26 maximum permissible value

rules.statement: a measuring verb governs the value in its own clause ("we measured 38 dB"): role result.
a measuring verb governs the value in its own clause ("we measured 38 dB"): nature measured.
a measuring verb governs the value in its own clause ("we measured 38 dB"): provenance publisher.
a first-person test statement in the value's clause ("in our test it reached 412 nits"): role result.
a first-person test statement in the value's clause ("in our test it reached 412 nits"): nature measured.
a first-person test statement in the value's clause ("in our test it reached 412 nits"): provenance publisher.
a verb reporting what the product did ("it lasted 48 minutes"): role result.
a verb reporting what the product did ("it lasted 48 minutes"): nature measured.
the value modifies a noun as a stable attribute ("a 3 L dust bag"): role specification.
the value modifies a noun as a stable attribute ("a 3 L dust bag"): nature declared.
a verb attributing a capability or component ("has", "features", "comes with"): role specification.
a verb attributing a capability or component ("has", "features", "comes with"): nature declared.
the value is a maker's claim or rating ("rated", "claims", "advertised", "according to the manufacturer"): role specification.
the value is a maker's claim or rating ("rated", "claims", "advertised", "according to the manufacturer"): nature declared.
the value is a maker's claim or rating ("rated", "claims", "advertised", "according to the manufacturer"): provenance manufacturer.
a certification or rating body states the value (AHAM, ENERGY STAR): role specification.
a certification or rating body states the value (AHAM, ENERGY STAR): nature declared.
a certification or rating body states the value (AHAM, ENERGY STAR): provenance third_party.
the value is a setting or circumstance of the test ("at 1 m", "on the 40 C programme"): role condition.
the value is a setting or circumstance of the test ("at 1 m", "on the 40 C programme"): nature condition.
the value is the output of a calculation or estimate ("an estimated 30 kWh", "which works out at"): role result.
the value is the output of a calculation or estimate ("an estimated 30 kWh", "which works out at"): nature calculated.
the value is what a test or a buyer aims at ("ideally", "you want"): role target.
a standard, regulation or guideline sets the value ("the standard requires", "regulations limit"): role norm.
rules.source: JCGM 200:2012 (VIM) 2.10 measured quantity value vs 4.26 maximum permissible value

rules.statement: a bound in a generic or sufficiency claim ("anything under 45 dB", "quiet enough"): role threshold.
a test or measurement term in the cell: role result.
a test or measurement term in the cell: nature measured.
a test or measurement term in the cell: provenance publisher.
a declaration or specification term in the cell ("claimed", "rated", "spec"): role specification.
a declaration or specification term in the cell ("claimed", "rated", "spec"): nature declared.
a certification term in the cell: role specification.
a certification term in the cell: nature declared.
a certification term in the cell: provenance third_party.
an estimate or calculation term in the cell: role result.
an estimate or calculation term in the cell: nature calculated.
a test or measurement term in the cell's row or column labels: role result.
a test or measurement term in the cell's row or column labels: nature measured.
a test or measurement term in the cell's row or column labels: provenance publisher.
a declaration or specification term in the cell's row or column labels ("claimed", "rated", "spec"): role specification.
a declaration or specification term in the cell's row or column labels ("claimed", "rated", "spec"): nature declared.
a certification term in the cell's row or column labels: role specification.
a certification term in the cell's row or column labels: nature declared.
a certification term in the cell's row or column labels: provenance third_party.
an estimate or calculation term in the cell's row or column labels: role result.
an estimate or calculation term in the cell's row or column labels: nature calculated.
in its record the value is a condition another value requires (quantity-knowledge record rule P1): role condition.
in its record the value is a condition another value requires (quantity-knowledge record rule P1): nature condition.
a test statement elsewhere in the value's sentence (not in its clause): role result.
a test statement elsewhere in the value's sentence (not in its clause): nature measured.
a test statement elsewhere in the value's sentence (not in its clause): provenance publisher.
a declaration statement elsewhere in the value's sentence: role specification.
a declaration statement elsewhere in the value's sentence: nature declared.
a test or measurement term in the table's caption or heading: role result.
a test or measurement term in the table's caption or heading: nature measured.
a test or measurement term in the table's caption or heading: provenance publisher.
a declaration or specification term in the table's caption or heading: role specification.
a declaration or specification term in the table's caption or heading: nature declared.
a certification term in the table's caption or heading: role specification.
a certification term in the table's caption or heading: nature declared.
a certification term in the table's caption or heading: provenance third_party.
an estimate or calculation term in the table's caption or heading: role result.
an estimate or calculation term in the table's caption or heading: nature calculated.
a test or measurement term in a statement linked to the table or a section heading: role result.
a test or measurement term in a statement linked to the table or a section heading: nature measured.
a test or measurement term in a statement linked to the table or a section heading: provenance publisher.
a declaration or specification term in a statement linked to the table or a section heading: role specification.
a declaration or specification term in a statement linked to the table or a section heading: nature declared.
a certification term in a statement linked to the table or a section heading: role specification.
a certification term in a statement linked to the table or a section heading: nature declared.
a certification term in a statement linked to the table or a section heading: provenance third_party.
an estimate or calculation term in a statement linked to the table or a section heading: role result.
an estimate or calculation term in a statement linked to the table or a section heading: nature calculated.
the document states its own test protocol and the value is a result the protocol produces (Phase265 energy protocol, plan-guided term with document testing): role result.
the document states its own test protocol and the value is a result the protocol produces (Phase265 energy protocol, plan-guided term with document testing): nature measured.
the document states its own test protocol and the value is a result the protocol produces (Phase265 energy protocol, plan-guided term with document testing): provenance publisher.
the whole document is a maker's or seller's page (source type): role specification.
the whole document is a maker's or seller's page (source type): nature declared.
the whole document is a maker's or seller's page (source type): provenance manufacturer.
the page reports tests somewhere (audit S77 A1-16 page default): a presumption, never a decision: role result.
the page reports tests somewhere (audit S77 A1-16 page default): a presumption, never a decision: nature measured.
Phase245 found the value in a specification-like row: a presumption, never a decision: role specification.
Phase245 found the value in a specification-like row: a presumption, never a decision: nature declared.
Phase265 screened the value as a test lead: a presumption, never a decision: role result.
Phase265 screened the value as a test lead: a presumption, never a decision: nature measured.

contested.why: Different statements about one occurrence can disagree (a maker's claim and a measurement in one clause, a condition cue and a result verb): at equal authority and scope PEE abstains and reports the conflict.
A measurement verb and a calculation or declaration cue in one clause leave the nature undecided.
A first-person test and a maker's or certifier's statement about one value leave the provenance undecided.
Context of one scope can name both a test and a specification (a heading 'specs and test results'): undecided.
Context naming measurement and declaration or estimate at one scope leaves the nature undecided.
Context naming the publisher's test and a maker's or certifier's statement at one scope leaves the provenance undecided.

history.note: S100 development (spent S89-S99 material): the S92 situation type 'episodic' decided 15 roles, 8 correctly; an event reading of a verb is not evidence that a value was measured. Rules OS11 and OS12 removed. Page titles are no longer read as section headings, and a calculation cue needs a calculation operator (reader changes, same rules).
